content: Better Auth 1.x Next.js: server instance via betterAuth({emailAndPassword:{enabled:true}, plugins:[organization({...}), nextCookies()]}). Mount catch-all at app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts via toNextJsHandler(auth) exporting {GET,POST} from 'better-auth/next-js'. Server session: auth.api.getSession({headers: await headers()}). requireEmailVerification defaults false.
